name: terence-media-hub
description: Terence Media Hub: internal media asset management (Next.js frontend, Express backend, Firebase, local SSD storage)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tmh/frontend && npm run build -w @tmh/backend

scripts.test: npm run test -w @tmh/frontend && npm run test -w @tmh/backend
